preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Run the native command, capture LASTEXITCODE immediately, and classify success from zero.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never use stdout truthiness for merge-base or cat-file existence checks.

preferred_methods.title: Classify zero-output native commands by exit code

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Add only the exact new family-current script paths to the existing non-cone sparse-checkout definition, then stage the same reviewed path set.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Before staging a new repository-local tool in a sparse lane, add its exact path to the sparse definition and remeasure the materialized surface.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed staging attempt, leave the index content inspectable, and add only the missing paths without disabling sparse checkout.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local sparse worktree recovery only.
preferred_methods.title: Extend sparse checkout for exact new tool paths before staging
trigger_preconditions: Git reports that intended owner-scoped files are outside the sparse-checkout definition.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Bind the repository root into the validator's script-mode import path, split scanner self-test literals so they are not misclassified as data hits, preserve the failed receipt, and write the corrected pass separately.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Validators invoked by file path must add the repository root before named test imports, and self-scanner fixtures must be classified or constructed without becoming data candidates.
preferred_methods.rollback: Leave the failed receipt immutable, patch only import and scanner-definition domains, regenerate the index manifest with both receipt exclusions, and rerun the authoritative evidence validator once.
preferred_methods.title: Separate validator import roots and scanner definitions from evidence data
trigger_preconditions: A validator passes direct tests but its script-mode loader cannot import named test modules, or scanner definitions match their own literals.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Anchor forbidden lifecycle checks to the phase-root closeout, seal, and final directories rather than matching every nested path segment containing the word final.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Lifecycle path guards must use a phase-root anchored directory expression and report the matched paths before stopping.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed wrapper at zero credit, change no staged content, and rerun only the anchored path classifier.
preferred_methods.title: Anchor lifecycle path guards to phase-root directories
trigger_preconditions: A forbidden-lifecycle regex matches legitimate nested tooling directories whose names contain final.
